domains.name: Knowledge Base Content
domains.description: Product documentation, GitHub markdown files, and SharePoint runbooks used for context retrieval.

domains.name: Customer Support Tickets
domains.description: Historical and incoming support tickets including ticket content, metadata, and routing decisions.

domains.name: Audit and Evaluation Data
domains.description: Source attribution logs, AI draft generation logs, PII redaction audit trails, and quality evaluation datasets.

ingestion.text: Data ingestion pulls product documentation, Markdown files, runbooks, and Zendesk tickets on a bi-weekly cadence via API integration. The ingestion orchestrator routes incoming streams through an event bus to handle scheduled updates and ticket events seamlessly.

transactional_storage.text: Transactional operational data, active session metadata, and system configuration are stored in an operational relational database. The storage schema supports real-time concurrent ticket interaction and low-latency state processing.

analytical_storage.text: Knowledge text chunks and ticket content are vectorized and indexed within an enterprise hybrid search index. This repository supports semantic similarity retrieval and term disambiguation across product lines.

quality.text: Data quality filtering down-weights deprecated tickets older than 24 months and applies domain disambiguation. Document parsing pipelines enforce quality checks before indexing knowledge into vector stores.

metadata_governance.text: Metadata tags track documentation release dates, product lines, and ticket timestamps to control search indexing. Governance procedures maintain terminology mapping across four product lines and mandate periodic syncs.

retention.text: Source attribution logs and model call records are retained for 24 months to satisfy audit requirements. Deprecated historical tickets are excluded or down-weighted based on date metadata.

privacy_security.text: PII, pasted credentials, and hostnames are redacted prior to model invocation with full audit logging. Data residency is strictly enforced in EU regions without vendor model training or cross-border prompt retention.

reporting_analytics.text: Analytics track handle time reductions, routing accuracy, draft usage, and offline/online quality evaluation metrics. Telemetry logs store aggregate performance indicators for operational oversight.

backup_recovery.validation_reason: Specific recovery time and point objectives (RTO/RPO) were not provided by the customer.
backup_recovery.text: Automated cloud backup tools execute daily backups of relational databases and search index configurations. Specific recovery time and point objectives require customer confirmation during onboarding.
